zh: 修复 Worktree 下拉菜单中删除按钮挤压名称与分支导致无法显示的问题，并自动清理最近工作空间列表中已失效/不存在或过期的临时沙箱目录。
账号管理优化：同队成员超过 2 人时折叠展示并支持弹窗查看全部成员；单人团队绑定或换绑团队前提示原团队数据将丢失，切换后自动清理无人使用的团队空间。
en: Fixed the Worktree menu delete button squeezing directory and branch labels to zero width, and automatically prune missing or expired scratch directories from recent workspaces.

Account management improvements: collapse long teammate lists after 2 names with a view-all popover, warn before rebinding sole-member teams that original data will be lost, and clean up unused team spaces after rebinding.
